text: Seeds numerous, light or dark brown, grey (or black), compressed or tumid (with inflated sides), variable of shape, faces not or little sculptured, margin usually present, edge usually smooth, or crenate or undulate.

An erect to pendent epiphyte or lithophyte, often forming dense clumps. Stems up to 45 cm. long, unbranched or little branching, covered by persistent leaf-bases; roots little branched, 3–4 mm. in diameter. Leaves coriaceous, conduplicate, narrowly oblong, unequally roundly bilobed at the apex, 3.5–11.5 cm. long, 1–2.3 cm. wide, articulated to distichous, imbricate leaf-bases. Inflorescences spreading, 6–9 cm. long, 5–13-flowered; peduncle 1–1.5 cm. long; bracts 5–6.5 mm. long, drying black. Flowers very variable in size, white fading to yellow, greenish on the outer surface and spur, diurnally scented; pedicel and ovary 2.5–5.5 cm. long, scabrid. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, 1–2.5 cm. long, 2.7–5.6 mm. wide. Petals lanceolate, acuminate, 0.9–2.1 cm. long, 2.2–5 mm. wide. Lip obscurely 3-lobed in the middle, 10–24 mm. long, 5–11 mm. wide; side lobes rounded; mid-lobe lanceolate; spur pendent, filiform, 7.5–16 cm. long. Column 4.5–5 mm. long; stipes bifid, each lobe linear; viscidium oblong. Pl. 7.
